items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 17:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Benjamin, a male power? The spirit that her husband casts into her in the first union, namely from the aspect of the Mochin that come out upon the Mazalot, which are male MAN, is called Benjamin included in Joseph, in the secret of the verse “and his father called him Benjamin”, meaning from the aspect that he is included in his father, who is male. He is called “Ben Yamin (son of the right hand), a male power”, for the right hand is always male, and therefore this name alludes to the male power within it, namely Benjamin included in Joseph. For this is because the MAN of the Mochin is the aspect of the Yesod of Malchut, and not actual Malchut. As above, in Answers 6 and 7. And the vessel of the Yesod of the Nukva, corrected by this spirit called Benjamin, is called Ben Oni. As above in Answer 13. (Item 105).
